articles.image_title: Studienorientierung: Mehr als Bundesjugendspiele

articles.title: Gianni Infantino: Fifa und Infantino sollen Kontakte zu US-Regierung offenlegen

articles.image_title: Jamie Raskin FIFA Gianni Infantino Donald Trump

articles.image_title: WM-Finale 1954: Die Wunde von Bern

articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); WM-Finale 1970: Der beste Weltmeister, den es je gab
articles.teaser: Jogo bonito. Mit ihrem WM-Sieg 1970 begründen die Brasilianer um Pelé ihren Ruf als Meister des schönen Spiels. Nirgendwo wird das so deutlich wie bei diesem einen Tor.
articles.image_title: WM-Finale 1970: FILE - Brazil's Pele is hoisted on the shoulders of his teammates after Brazil won the World Cup final against Italy, 4-1, in Mexico City's Estadio Azteca, June 21, 1970. A Brazilian dictionary has added “Pelé” as an adjective to use when describing someone who is “exceptional, incomparable, unique.” The announcement by the Michaelis dictionary on Wednesday, April 26, 2023, is part of a campaign that gathered more than 125,000 signatures to honor the late soccer great’s impact beyond his sport. (AP Photo, File)

articles.image_title: Laufen für Anfänger: rechts: GRUENHEIDE, GERMANY - JANUARY 21: (EDITORS NOTE: Image taken with a drone.) In this aerial view trees stand on the forest property where US automaker Tesla is to build a new Gigafactory on January 21, 2020 near Gruenheide, Germany. Tesla and the state of Brandenburg recently sealed the sale of the property, located near Berlin, to Tesla. A small group of local citizens have voiced opposition to the new factory over concerns for the plant's exptected high water consumption as well as the felling of trees to make way for the assembly halls. Tesla plans on rolling out new electric cars from the plant by the summer of 2021. (Photo by Sean Gallup/Getty Images)
